intention: A proof run cannot write into the live instance tree, so every record standing in ~/.cairn/logs is something that actually happened.
why: MEASURED 2026-08-18, hours after the trail gained its default: 2,080 records stand across 8 device trails in ~/.cairn/logs, and at least 440 of them are FIXTURES — pointers like validation-verdict-changed-test-thing, ground-loop-device-liar, ground-loop-device-broken, invented so a proof could watch a device react to them, re-appended on every `bin/cmd/test` run. They are not in a separate file that could be dropped whole: they are interleaved with real records of identical shape, in the trail whose most frequent pointer (224 hits, ground-loop-is-older-than-the-code-it-judges) IS a real trouble on file in the commons. Nothing marks which is which. THE LIVED SYMPTOM is the one this whole tree exists to remove: a mind arrives at a red, reads the logs for the picture of what just happened, and roughly one record in five describes an event that never occurred — so the surface built to save an exploration funds a wrong one instead. THE DEFECT IN ONE SENTENCE: the seam that isolates a proof's trail EXISTS and is optional — set_diagnostic_roots, proven in test_device_logs_unwired.py, used by 2 proofs of 126 — which is policy standing exactly where physics belongs (Law 4). AND THE REASON IS SPECIFIC, not general sloppiness: every OTHER store in the corpus isolates by construction, because its caller must hand it a root and there is no default to forget (the commons troubles store is clean). The trail is the one store with a default that resolves to the live world, and it grew that default this morning — in the same act that made an unwired device log, which was the right change. A store with a live default is one forgotten line from seeding the instrument it is about to read, which is a failure this corpus has already measured twice (15 of 19 production rows written by their own test). AKIEN'S FRAMING, 2026-08-18: 'so what you're saying is we need a test-fixture space that's not part of the main workspaces' — and his ruling on where it belongs: 'it can still share the parent logging ticket as parent. folding it in would add a more specific into a less specific. less good that.'
how: HOME IS ALREADY THE DIAL, and finding that is what makes this cheap. address.py computes _INSTANCE = Path.home() / '.cairn' at import, and Path.home() reads $HOME through pathlib — which the floor already imports — so pointing a proof's subprocess at a temp HOME relocates the WHOLE instance root with no change to address.py and no new import. MEASURED BEFORE CASTING (Law 3): a fixture record aimed at the trouble device under a temp HOME landed in the temp world, and the live trail stayed at 292 records. THE OWNER ALREADY EXISTS and it is the tester — cairn/devices/tester/isolation.py already owns what a proof can reach, with a MEASURED network seal — so this extends an existing remit from the network to instance-space rather than minting a mechanism, and it inherits that seal's discipline verbatim: PROBED FROM INSIDE, never assumed, an unconfirmable seal INDETERMINATE rather than green. THE OBVIOUS IMPLEMENTATION IS THE WRONG ONE and is recorded here so it is not re-derived: putting the dial inside address.py would satisfy this ticket and break that module's charter bound (it resolves and never touches disk; its single-import floor is a measured claim two other proofs' allowlists admit by name). The environment is the dial instead. Bwrap bind-mounting a temp dir over ~/.cairn is the hardening above the floor, not the floor — it is opt-in per run and absent on some hosts.
traces_to: Law 7 first — a record of truth may never carry an invented record, and 440 of 2,080 describe events that never occurred, in the same files and the same shape as the ones that did. Law 8 — a proof that seeds the tree it later reads is the hollow build by construction. Law 4 — the seam that would fix it exists and is optional, which is policy where physics belongs. Law 3 — the tree is the corpus's record of what was observed, and a fifth of it is fiction.
gates: code-seam invariant, transcribed: PROVED, and feeds-back-to-origin-on-failure (Laws 3 + 8). PROVE GATE: the tester runs the proof beside the component it changes — cairn/devices/tester/ — with at least one tooth a hollow build could not pass: a BEFORE/AFTER byte witness over the real ~/.cairn/logs across a proof run that DOES emit, so the tooth reads the world rather than asking the tester whether it isolated. A second non-hollow tooth is required by the prior art: the seal is probed FROM INSIDE the run (the subject asserts its own resolved instance root is not the live one) and an unconfirmable seal is INDETERMINATE, never green — isolation.py's rule, inherited verbatim. DURABILITY GATE: not done until proven AND committed (git). WATCH GATE: WATCHME(a_proof_cannot_seed_the_tree_it_reads), spec in `watchme`, probe armed at the berth it names. PARENT GATE: this is the fourth child of every-boundary-crossing-lands-in-the-logs-tree and proves before that parent crosses PROVED.
falsifier: DONE when a full `bin/cmd/test` run leaves ~/.cairn/logs byte-identical — asserted by the tester over its own run, the byte-witness shape already carried by bin/proofs/test_delete_gate.py, never a human reading a diff. WRONG INTENT if: the isolation is set but never probed from inside, so a proof that escaped it still reports green (the hollow seal — isolation.py's falsifier clause (5) names exactly this shape one resource over); or it is bought by making every proof remember a call, which is the policy it replaces wearing a new name; or relocating HOME breaks a component that hand-spells an absolute instance path rather than resolving through address.py — in which case the census of those sites is the finding, and it is a better one than the one intended.
horizon: the next full corpus run after the seam lands — measurable the same day, needing no clock and no live host. No later than the parent's own crossing, which this gates: the parent measures coverage as trails-on-disk, and that number cannot be read honestly while a fifth of the records in it are staged.
children: none, because it is a leaf: one seam (the point where the tester spawns a proof subprocess), one owner, one proof. The one thing that could have been a child — cleaning the 440 fixture records already standing in the live tree — is deliberately NOT one: it is an act on a record of truth needing its own answer under Law 7 (append a retraction, drop the trails, or leave them and mark the era), and it does not gate this build, which changes only what happens next. It is named in missing_check as out of scope rather than left to be rediscovered.

watchme.trigger: each full corpus run — it rides the run the tester already performs, never a clock, and needs no live host and no inference: it compares bytes in ~/.cairn/logs before and after a run that has already happened.
watchme.enough: NOT satisfied by the corpus it was written against — a floor proved only by the proofs that already exist is a claim about nothing. Enough when the invariant has held across at least TWO proofs written AFTER this ticket lands, because the failure being watched for is a NEW proof reintroducing the default: the seam makes isolation the resting state, and the question the watch answers is whether a proof written next month inherits it without its author knowing it exists. Same enough-clause shape as the parent's, deliberately borrowed.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying the two byte-counts it compares (live logs before, live logs after) and the count of proofs written since the ticket landed — measured values rather than a pass word, so a later reader sees whether the coverage claim moved or merely repeated.
watchme.nexus: the diagnostic nexus — what a mind needs on disk to diagnose a red without a second exploration. It teaches the same tree diagnostic_inspector's filters read, and its specific contribution is the honesty of that tree rather than its size.
watchme.consumer: CC at the moment of a red, through diagnostic_inspector — the surface that would otherwise present a fixture as evidence of something that happened; and Akien at session-open if the tree starts taking writes from proofs again.

from_idea: none, because it was born of a measurement taken while answering Akien's question in the session of 2026-08-18, and he ruled the same hour that it be cast as a fourth child of every-boundary-crossing-lands-in-the-logs-tree rather than folded into it. That parent ticket is the resolvable referent; its children field names this node.
provenance: Born 2026-08-18 out of Akien's question 'i think from what you said the proof pollution is actually just that we have no data, and the data will accumulate over time. did i have that right?' — the answer was no, and the correction is this ticket: not scarcity, contamination. His follow-up named the shape ('a test-fixture space that's not part of the main workspaces') and his ruling placed it as a child rather than a fold. The question is also what unstuck it: CC had told him an hour earlier that making proof-isolation physical would cost address.py its single-import floor. It does not — Path.home() reads $HOME through pathlib — and that was an invented blocker, measured shut before this cast.
distinctions_recorded: NOT a collision with the tester's network seal, though it is the nearest neighbour: one keeps a proof off the network, this keeps it out of the live instance root. Same owner, same discipline, different resource. The distinction belongs on the tester's charter — instance-space is the seal's second resource — and the seal's inside-probe rule crosses to it unchanged.

NOT a collision with address.py's no-touch-disk bound, and the reason is load-bearing: this seam changes the ENVIRONMENT address.py resolves in, and adds no read, no import and no branch to the module. A build that put the dial inside address.py would satisfy this ticket and break that one.

The parent's coverage number (trails-on-disk against components-that-emit) will DROP when the fixtures stop being written. That is the number becoming honest rather than regressing, and the parent's watchme already carries measured counts rather than a pass word precisely so a reader can tell which.

OUT OF SCOPE, deliberately: the 440 fixture records already standing in the live tree. Cleaning them is an act on a record of truth needing its own answer under Law 7 (append a retraction, drop the trails, or leave them and mark the era). It does not gate this build, which changes only what happens next.
